title: Cross-Realm Auction
description: An auction that spans multiple realms (mortal + immortal). Rare spirit beasts, artifacts, dao maps. Huge risk and exposure.
description_add: Stalls glow with odd lights; a shiver runs through the crowd when an immortal-grade blade is displayed.

choices.text: Use the event to gather intel

title: Escort Diplomat to Immortal Sect
description: You're tasked with escorting a mortal diplomat through dangerous territory to an immortal sect meeting. Monsters, rival spies, etc.
description_add: Your caravan moves like a heartbeat; every shadow may hold a blade or a benefactor.

title: Trade Route Negotiation
description: Your sect negotiates with merchant guilds (mortal and immortal) for favorable trade routes. Reputation, profit, political leverage at stake.
description_add: Merchants speak in numbers and omens; contracts are signed with ink and qi-binding seals.

title: Expedition Into the Demon Realm
description: A dangerous expedition is proposed into the demon realm for lost treasures, dao seeds, or forbidden techniques.
description_add: The air tastes of brimstone and possibility; each step deeper risks more than just the body.

title: Market of Heavenly Goods
description: A celestial-market event where goods from immortal realms are sold. Quality high; tricksters abound.
description_add: A vendor's laugh hides a trick; a true relic hums with memory when you touch it.

title: Dungeon Delving With Sect Allies
description: You join with disciples from other sects to delve into a dangerous dungeon (ancient ruin, spirit realm). Co-op, rivalry, traps, boss beasts.
description_add: Torches gutter as the stone breathes; allies watch your back and your shadow.

title: Intersect Council Call
description: Top sects, immortal branches, perhaps even the Heavenly Court convene to address rising threats. You may be called as representative.
description_add: The hall smells of incense and strategy; you learn more from a pause than a speech.

title: Spirit Beast Coliseum
description: A coliseum-style event where spirit beasts are pitted in spectacle. Your role: sponsor, referee, or competitor (if you have a beast companion).
description_add: Beasts scream like thunder; the crowd's delight is a currency as potent as spirit stones.

title: Heavenly Merchant Guild Raid
description: Bandits or rogue disciples raid a merchant caravan from the Heavenly Merchant Guild. Your sect asks you to recover or retaliate.
description_add: Tracks vanish and scent-motes swirl; the trail favors those who read more than footprints.

title: Artifact Conclave at Heavenly Palace
description: The Heavenly Palace calls a conclave to display artifacts, test relics, judge authenticity. Many eyes (and spies) on you.
description_add: A relic's hum betrays truth; every nod carries consequence in ways coin cannot measure.

title: Dual Path to Breakthrough
description: You discover two possible paths for your breakthrough: one orthodox, one forbidden or untested. Each gives different risks/rewards.

title: Recover Lost City of Immortals
description: An immortal city lost in time is found beneath a veil. You lead expedition to recover or secure it before others do.

title: Spiritual Trade Agreement
description: Various sects and mortal realms negotiate trade of spiritual ingredients, spirit beasts, qi seeds. Laws, tariffs, and smuggling involved.

title: Healing Disaster in Immortal Branch
description: An immortal branch has a healing hall that catastrophically fails: a tainted herb, wrong ritual, many disciples fall ill. Sect reputation on line.

title: Nexus of Realms Encounter
description: You discover a realm nexus—a point where mortal/immortal/demonic realms meet. Strange creatures, laws warp, vast potential rewards and dangers.

title: Rival Sect Sabotage on Trade Route
description: A trade route important to your sect is sabotaged by rival sect disciples or demonic agents. Loss of reputation, supplies, or face.

title: Heavenly Court Trial
description: The Heavenly Court summons you (or your sect) to answer allegations or participate in trial for transgressions. Stakes include loss of status, relics, maybe exile.

title: Domain Gateway Unlocked
description: A gateway to your sect domain opens—it grants passive realm-wide benefits if claimed, but also makes you visible to enemies.

title: Celestial Beast Offering
description: A celestial beast offers you or your sect a gift—boon, technique, or challenge. Accepting may bind you in unexpected ways.

title: Treaty with Darkness Sect
description: A treaty is proposed with Darkness Sect: forbid raids, share knowledge, mutual non-interference. But maybe one side will break it.

title: Spiritual Crisis in Mortal Realm
description: Mortal world is suffering from spiritual decay: rains fail, beasts mutate, people turn feral. Immortal sects pressured to intervene.

choices.text: Let mortal sects or local government handle

title: Ruin Underneath Sect Halls
description: While building expansion for sect halls, you discover ancient ruins below with dangerous qi anomalies. To explore or seal away?

title: Unification Pressure from Immortal Factions
description: Some immortal branches propose to unify sects under a larger banner—be it Heavenly Dao, Void Emperor, or others. Many see chance, many see threat to independence.

title: Domain & Realm Tournament
description: A tournament that pits disciples from different realms against each other: mortal, immortal, demonic. The rules are loose; danger is high.

title: Master & Apprentice Reckoning
description: Your master’s past is revealed: perhaps a betrayal, secret pact, or shame. You must choose whether to draw a line or defend their honor.

title: Shattered Alliance Revenge
description: An ally sect betrays your sect in a major crisis. Losses, reputational damage. Do you retaliate or rebuild peace?

title: Heavenly Emperor’s Attention
description: The Heavenly Emperor (or equivalent high immortal power) notices your deeds. Could be a boon, could be demand of service, or summons to trial.

title: Spirit Sea Navigation
description: The spirit sea—a vast spiritual ocean realm—opens up for navigators. You must navigate storms of qi, pirate spirit ships, and rewards beyond imagining.

title: Mortal World Integration
description: Your sect is officially establishing a base in the mortal realm: trade, teaching, protection. Public reactions vary.

title: Demonstration of Immortal Branch Power
description: An immortal branch of your sect (or rival) opens a display of their high cultivation—floating palaces, spirit storms, etc. Spectacle and envy ensue.

title: Guardians of the Ancient Tree
description: An ancient tree spirit with world-shaping power is threatened by deforestation or ambition. Protect or exploit its power?

title: Heir of Sect Lineage Claim
description: Someone claims they are the rightful heir to a legendary sect patriarch. Claim or expose? Might shift power dynamics.
